# symplotting

`CAIMEOX/symbit/symplotting` is the public import path for this package.

Symbolic plotting frontends, plot series objects, text plotting, uniform/adaptive sampling, and implicit plotting utilities for the plotting runtime surface.

## When To Use This Package

- Import `CAIMEOX/symbit/symplotting` directly when you want plotting-specific entry points instead of the root facade.
- Use this package to build plot objects, inspect sampled data, or render text plots from symbolic expressions.

## Key Public Entry Points

- `textplot`
- `textplot_str`
- `plot`
- `plot_parametric`
- `plot3d`
- `plot_contour`
- `plot_implicit`

## Example

```mbt check
///|
test "symplotting can build line and implicit plots" {
  let x = @symcore.Expr::Symbol("x")
  let y = @symcore.Expr::Symbol("y")

  let lines = textplot_str(
    @symcore.function("sin", [x]),
    @symcore.int(-3),
    @symcore.int(3),
  )
  assert_true(lines.length() > 0)

  let p = plot([plot_expr(@symcore.function("sin", [x]))], show=false, n=20)
  let (xs, ys) = p.get_data(0)
  assert_true(xs.length() == 20)
  assert_true(xs.length() == ys.length())

  let implicit = plot_implicit(Relational(Gt, y, x), show=false)
  match implicit.get_implicit_data(0) {
    Fill(rectangles) => assert_true(rectangles.length() > 0)
    Mesh(_, _, _, _) => fail("expected adaptive fill data")
  }
}
```
